title: Can I Learn the King's Gambit in 24 Hours?
summary: Opening-learning challenge: learn the King's Gambit in 24 hours on chessreps.com (22 lines), practise in a streak/score drill and the arena bot, then use it to beat a 2000-rated opponent in a normal game - he wins.

opponent.name: ~2000-rated human (rated pool)

current_impl_issues: Forced King's Gambit opening vs bot is a reasonable approximation; there is no variant. Optional: an opening-drill mini-mode (play the book line, score +1 per correct move).
